notes: Budgets are design inputs, not an implemented engine allocator.
Retained delta cap includes active, frozen and old-query-pinned records together.
Retained generations include old query references; stop publication or admission at cap.
Background build may start only after cache shrinks and resource reservations succeed.
Whole-index rebuild within this limit is unproven; test bounded partitioning before enabling it.
Phase-two build/rebuild fixtures use a separate 512 MiB job limit.
First bulk build and official memory rules remain separate follow-up acceptance items.
